 KBL Cancels Fine for KT's Trey Porter After Technical Foul Over Protest
 Ha Seong-nyong 
 Seoul 
 Published 
 2026.11.19 18:44 
 View 
 View Count 
 Enlarge image 
 ▲ Trey Porter of KT 
 Suwon KT's foreign basketball player Trey Porter, who received a technical foul for excessive protesting during a game, will no longer have to pay a fine following a re-examination. 
 The Korean Basketball League (KBL) held its 3rd Finance Committee meeting of the 32nd term and decided to cancel the imposition of a fine (200,000 won) for Porter's technical foul. 
 Porter received a technical foul during the second quarter of a regular-season away game against the Seoul SK Knights held at Jamsil Students' Gymnasium in Seoul on October 25, after being penalized for a foul during defensive play and protesting excessively. 
 However, as the player maintained that he was unfairly penalized, the club requested a re-examination, resulting in the committee revoking the fine. 
 A KBL official stated that it was difficult to clearly verify the situation through video footage and explained, "We determined that it was necessary to be cautious about maintaining a disadvantage such as a fine against a player when clear facts cannot be confirmed." 
 (Photo provided by KBL, Yonhap News)
